claims.statement: The guide's purpose is to inform the design and delivery of CHW education and training curricula, to strengthen primary health care and essential services in communities.
claims.quote: The objective of this global competency-based curriculum guide for CHWs is to inform the conceptualization, design and implementation of CHW education and training curricula in order to ultimately strengthen primary health care and delivery of essential services at community level.
claims.reason: every citation quotes the source exactly

claims.statement: The guide is organised into six competency domains, 12 universal modules and four role-specific modules covering 28 topics.
claims.quote: The content is organized into six competency domains, 12 universal modules (11 practice activities plus one module of basic science knowledge), and four role-specific modules, comprising 28 role-specific topics organized under the four modules.
claims.locator: 3.1 Overview of the CHW curriculum guide
claims.reason: every citation quotes the source exactly

claims.statement: The guide says most volunteer CHWs, or those working only a few hours a week, cannot carry out all the universal practice activities it expects.
claims.quote: Most volunteer CHWs, or those working only a few hours a week, cannot reasonably carry out all the universal practice activities expected of all CHWs in this framework.
claims.reason: every citation quotes the source exactly

claims.statement: No CHW is expected to carry out all the role-specific tasks, so content must be selected to fit the role and context.
claims.quote: No CHW can carry out all of the practice activities and tasks outlined in the role-specific modules in this framework.
claims.locator: 3.1 Overview of the CHW curriculum guide
claims.reason: every citation quotes the source exactly

claims.statement: Integrating CHWs into the health system has considerable resource implications that should be funded through national budgets.
claims.quote: This level of health system integration has considerable resource implications, which should be supported also through inclusion of capital investments and regular recurrent costs in national budgets.
claims.locator: 4. Health policy and health system support for CHW integration in primary health care
claims.reason: every citation quotes the source exactly

claims.statement: The guide recommends updating the curriculum regularly, for example at least every 5 to 10 years.
claims.quote: deliver, evaluate and update the new curriculum as regularly as needed (indicated by programme evaluation) or periodically, for example at least every 5–10 years.
claims.locator: 3.3 How to use the curriculum guide
claims.reason: every citation quotes the source exactly
